ruling: - **R20. A pass claim needs a verdict line.** Owner 17:17 CST Nov 10, quoting a session: "I told you several earlier lane lint runs "passed". They did not. Every run exited 1, and I misread my own echo exit code as the lint's"; 18:36 CST: "yes". Rule tokens-run-through-verdict is enforced by nothing on main (only quoted in a guard_stream.py remedy). (1) A "passed", "green" or "clean" claim in a report or a message to a parent cites a verdict line from this session's verdict log. The report guard refuses an uncited claim, remedy "run it through verdict". (2) Lint, ci-job, tests and the merge tool's release check run only through `verdict`; a bare run is refused with that form. Both run inside existing guards; no new process. Home: CLAUDE.md tokens-run-through-verdict; decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner.
